## History

Stella Maynard became one of Anne's close friends as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) adjusted to life at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). Along with her classmates, Stella anxiously discussed her upcoming examinations and future prospects as spring arrived. She then attended the Commencement ceremony where the results were announced, marking the end of the term.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P2](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P9](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stella-maynard.md)

Stella Maynard and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) are intimate friends who bonded during their time studying at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). They share a close academic connection and discuss their upcoming final examinations and future prospects together as the term progresses. Their friendship provides mutual support while adjusting to life at the academy.
